page_title: BOL 1-1 UDI | Bologna v Udinese 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Juan Luca Sacchi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
90+6' Udinese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+6' Walace (Udinese) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Lukasz Skorupski stops the ball from going into the top of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.

90+5' OFF THE POST! Keinan Davis (Udinese) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. Brenner (Udinese) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
90+4' Good movement by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90+2' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

90+2' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Giovanni Fabbian releases Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
89' Keinan Davis (Udinese) picks up a yellow card.

88' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
88' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replaces Joshua Zirkzee.
88' The game has come to an end for Dan Ndoye. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
87' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to make a change. Brenner (Udinese) replaces Martin Payero.
87' Hassane Kamara comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
82' Martin Payero (Udinese) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Martin Payero (Udinese) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
80' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.

78' 1 - 1 Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top of the net and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 1:1.

77' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Bologna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
75' The referee is firm and issues Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) a deserved yellow card.
74' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
73' Martin Payero (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Udinese get a corner.
73' The resulting corner from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

72' Wow, what an escape. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' Keinan Davis (Udinese) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
70' It could have been a good chance to score! Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) fails to release Dan Ndoye with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Keinan Davis (Udinese) replaces Lorenzo Lucca.
68' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replacing Roberto Pereyra.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) will replace Stefan Posch.
68' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Nehuen Perez (Udinese) will miss the next game.
64' Sam Beukema (Bologna) sees a second yellow card and he can't continue in the game.
61' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

61' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Bologna are awarded a free kick.
60' Fabio Cannavaro is forced to make a change. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Joao Ferreira.

59' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Maduka Okoye pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner.
58' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
55' Sam Beukema (Bologna) is given a fully deserved yellow card. Sam Beukema (Bologna) will miss the next game.
54' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) receives a pass then lets rip from long range low towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
53' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
52' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) whips in a cross from the corner, but Maduka Okoye is well positioned and punches the ball away.

52' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.

50' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Maduka Okoye (Udinese). Maduka Okoye (Udinese) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
50' Sam Beukema (Bologna) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
50' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
49' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
49' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) comes off for Riccardo Orsolini.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) latches onto the free kick from Lazar Samardzic, but heads just wide of the left post from close range.
45+4' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul after Michel Aebischer (Bologna) hacks down one of his opponents. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45+1' 0 - 1 Goal! Martin Payero (Udinese) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Alexis Saelemaekers does a good job setting up Michel Aebischer (Bologna) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
44' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
44' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Bologna will take a corner kick.
43' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
42' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
41' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
39' Bologna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
36' The corner kick from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
35' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
33' Stefan Posch (Bologna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
32' 1:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
28' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
27' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Luca Sacchi signals. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Udinese.
27' Stefan Posch (Bologna) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
26' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
25' Stefan Posch (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' Stefan Posch (Bologna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) sends a long ball forward to Joshua Zirkzee, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
15' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
14' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle after Hassane Kamara (Udinese) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. That's a free kick to Bologna.
13' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
9' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

8' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.
7' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle after Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
6' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

5' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
4' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
